claims.text: The proposed summarization method achieves a BLEU score of 30.4 on the CNN/Daily Mail dataset.
The proposed summarization method achieves a METEOR score of 24.2 on the CNN/Daily Mail dataset.
The proposed summarization method achieves a ROUGE-1 score of 50.3 on the CNN/Daily Mail dataset.
The proposed summarization method achieves a ROUGE-2 score of 24.9 on the CNN/Daily Mail dataset.
Learning rates in the range of 3e-05 to 5e-05 achieve the optimal balance of stability and convergence speed.
Top-k sampling thresholds between k=30 and k=50 yield the highest BLEU scores for generated summaries.
Training data noise ratios exceeding 0.3 cause a significant decline in summarization performance measured by BLEU and ROUGE-1.

Learning rate sensitivity experiments shown in Figure 2 demonstrate optimal stability and speed at 3e-05 to 5e-05.
Top-k threshold sensitivity experiments shown in Figure 3 demonstrate peak BLEU performance when k is set from 30 to 50.
Training data noise ratio experiments shown in Figure 4 demonstrate a significant decline in BLEU and ROUGE-1 when noise exceeds 0.3.

methodologies.name: Uncertainty-Quantified and Risk-Aware Conditional Generation Framework
methodologies.description: A conditional text generation framework integrating Bayesian parameter perturbation, predictive distribution entropy regularization, and context-sensitive risk-aware loss joint optimization.
conditions: Top-k sampling threshold k=30 to k=50

limitations.text: Model summarization quality degrades significantly when training data noise levels exceed 30%.
Setting Top-k sampling thresholds to k=60 or higher introduces low-confidence words that dilute risk-related information and reduce BLEU scores.
Traditional language models typically produce point predictions lacking confidence or risk descriptions.

future_work.text: Improve the refinement of risk modeling while maintaining computational efficiency.
Develop a unified risk-aware framework capable of adapting across cross-domain and cross-modal data sources.
